- **Approval:** I logged a request with June to put the rate in a mail to Hollis. I couldn't open a direct message to her from here, so I asked in our thread instead. It would help if you pinged June or Anselm directly too.
- **Once approved:** I'll save the draft in your mailbox, addressed to Hollis (hmbeki@pemberline.com), with the subject "Thornbury 2027 rate" and the rate you gave me.
- **Meanwhile:** I can save a draft to Hollis without the rate, or a copy with the rate addressed only to you.
